problems.unknown: We couldn’t confirm the outcome. Nothing is shown as done until SimpleFit confirms it. Try again: it can’t book or check anyone in twice.
problems.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this. Check your connection and try again.
problems.limited: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in {minutes} min.
problems.limitedLater: Too many requests in a short time. Try again a little later.
problems.full: This class is full ({capacity, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}). No booking was made, and there is no waitlist.
problems.fullSome: This class is full. No booking was made, and there is no waitlist.
problems.classCancelled: This class is cancelled. Nothing was booked or recorded.
problems.started: This class has already started, so bookings can’t change any more.
problems.notToday: Check-in is recorded on the day of the class. Nothing was recorded.
problems.alreadyBooked: You already have a place in this class. No second booking was made.
problems.checkedIn: This member is already checked in, so the booking stays.
problems.membership: Your membership of this gym isn’t active, so you can’t book its classes.
problems.membershipRequested: Your request to join this gym is still waiting for approval, so you can’t book yet.
problems.keyReused: This request couldn’t be matched. Reload the page and try again.
problems.forbidden: Your role can’t do this. Nothing changed.
problems.gone: This isn’t available to you. The page is up to date.
problems.session: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
problems.failed: Something went wrong and nothing changed. Try again.

roster.description: Who has booked this class, from SimpleFit’s records.
roster.classCancelled: This class is cancelled. Its bookings were released and no one can be checked in.
roster.checkInNote: Check members in as they arrive. Check-in is recorded on the day of the class, once per booking.

empty.confirmed: No one has booked this class yet.

roster.privacy: Only a short name and booking facts are shown. No email, profile or training data is part of a roster.

cancel.title: Cancel your booking?
cancel.body: Your place in {title} on {when} is released for someone else. You can book again while places are left.

gyms.title: My gyms

empty.title: You’re not a member of a gym
empty.body: When a gym approves you as a member, it appears here and you can book its classes. Joining a gym isn’t available on the web yet.

gyms.activeLine: Book classes and see your bookings
gyms.requestedLine: Waiting for the gym to approve your request
gyms.note: A gym membership needs no Fighter or Coach profile. SimpleFit shows only what the gym has recorded: no plan, payment or credits.

classes.title: Book a class

notMember.title: You’re not a member of this gym
notMember.body: Only a gym’s active members can see and book its classes.

requested.title: Your request is waiting
requested.body: {gym} hasn’t approved your request yet. You can book classes once you’re a member.

ended.title: Your membership isn’t active
ended.body: Your membership of {gym} has ended, so you can’t book its classes. Your past bookings stay in My bookings.

classes.hint: Choose a class to see its details and book a place.
classes.note: Places left can change at any moment: a booking counts only once SimpleFit confirms it.

places.full: Full · {capacity, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}

classes.confirmedNotice: Booking confirmed. Your place is saved.
classes.cancelledBefore: You cancelled an earlier booking of this class. You can book again while places are left.
classes.fullNotice: This class is full. There is no waitlist: check again later in case a place frees up.
classes.startedNotice: This class has started and can’t be booked.
classes.cancelNote: You can cancel until the class starts.
classes.startedBooked: This class has started. Your booking can’t be cancelled any more.

bookings.title: My bookings

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.body: Classes you book at your gyms appear here.

bookings.note: Bookings come from SimpleFit’s records. A check-in shows only when the gym recorded one.
